In our city in Iraq, there was the big major FOB which division headquarters was at, and then the CSH, and then several small FOBs scattered around the city, oh and the ODA house which was just in the middle of the city. All of the FOBs were no more than 2 miles from each other, except for the CSH, which was about 8-9 miles outside the city. The FOB I stayed at was just in the outskirts, on MSR Tampa.

Anyway, this 4th of July in mother fucking Iraq, someone too high ranking for anyone to tell him no decided that they were going to have a fireworks show for the American soldiers.... Reminder, we were in Iraq, we were foreign invaders that just overthrew their government and made their shithole country just a little bit more shitty.

A few of us gathered on the rooftop on our FOB, and there go the fireworks, we could see them from our position.

I was very vocal about how stupid this display of American dick waving was and how I hoped they were attacked. I was also thinking about the logistics of getting fireworks into Iraq. So many people had to sign off on this, and no where along the way did anyone stop and say, "Wait wait wait.... This is a really stupid idea."

We had the little non-secure Motorola radios we would use for communicating with our guard points, and we had guys guarding the Iraqi National Guard compound which was closer to the main FOB. They were even saying how stupid it was.

Less than a minute after the fireworks started, we could hear the booms.... Those aren't fireworks.... I guess the fireworks were on a timer because they were still shooting into the air while the FOB was being hit by mortars and rockets.

Oh man, it was the biggest "called it" moment of the entire deployment. I couldn't help myself but to laugh at the sheer stupidity of the situation. I mean, I was hoping no one was hurt, but it's like seeing someone kick a landmine - something else that happened that deployment, but that's another story. Yeah, if you see someone kicking a land mine, if they got blown up, I think the only thing I could do at that point would be to laugh at their stupidity.

The Iraqis only dropped 4-5 mortars + rockets into the FOB, but one of them hit the ammo point with AT4s and other American munitions stored, so there were additional booms and bangs after the fireworks and attack was over with. It went on for a good 10 minutes.

No one was hurt, thank God, but yeah, that was our 4th of July celebration in 2004... watching our own side get attacked and laughing at them.
